description:
Create a Shared Query named 'Stories without Tasks' that lists all User Stories in the TailwindTraders project that do not have any child Task work items. 

Starting state: Azure DevOps is open to the TailwindTraders project. The backlog contains a mix of User Stories; some have been broken down into Tasks, while others are 'orphaned' (no tasks).

Instructions:
1. Navigate to Boards > Queries.
2. Create a new query.
3. Configure it to find 'User Story' work items that DO NOT have any child 'Task' work items (use 'Work items and direct links' query type).
4. Save the query in the 'Shared Queries' folder as 'Stories without Tasks'.
